title: August and the Landfall
author: Ada Thackeray
blurb: Felix Dunmore, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, has spent fifteen years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
